info.title: LedgerBook payment history
info.description: Customer account payments are independent of bookings and remain pending until administrator approval. Approval credits the overall customer ledger exactly once. Existing booking payments and allocations are preserved. Admin corrections use compensating ledger entries and preserve audit history. Mutations require the configured Origin and X-CSRF-Protection: 1 header.

get.summary: List active payments or administrator trash

409.description: Stale version or invalid state; refresh before retrying

post.summary: Customer submits a payment with optional attachments
post.description: Customer owner only. Creates a pending review; no money is posted before admin approval. Repeat the same idempotency key with the same values/files to recover a lost response. Invoice payments retain the selected invoice_id. Only the latest outstanding invoice is eligible; stale selections or fully settled invoices/accounts return 409. Historical account submissions remain supported without an invoice.

409.description: Conflicting key, duplicate receipt, inactive account or booking

patch.summary: Edit payment amount, date or note
patch.description: Requires an active administrator and current version. Approved amount/date changes reverse the original ledger credit and post a replacement atomically. Note-only edits do not post money. Changing amount unlinks a mismatched installment without changing the scheduled amount. A financial edit of an externally reversed payment conflicts.

post.description: Administrator only. Posts received money with its actual past/current date, updates the booking paid balance and invoice, and records audit events in one transaction. Does not change reminders or send email. A UUID idempotency key is required; retain it for an unchanged retry. Changed requests with that key return 409. Cancelled bookings and inactive accounts cannot receive new payments.

post.description: Administrator only. Links one whole unassigned customer payment, retaining its original amount and date, without another ledger posting. Rejects reversed, future, foreign or already assigned payments. Does not change reminders or send email. A UUID idempotency key is required; retain it for an unchanged retry. Changed requests with that key return 409. Cancelled bookings and inactive accounts cannot receive new payments.

get.description: Customer owner or administrator. Returns account payment submissions and historical booking-linked payments for this customer. Use the returned booking_id when routing mutations: null uses account routes; a UUID uses the existing booking route. Deleted history is administrator-only.

post.summary: Customer submits a payment with optional attachments
post.description: Customer owner only. Submit positive GBP amount, actual payment date, optional note and zero to five PDF/image receipts as multipart/form-data. The payment has booking_id=null and booking_reference=null, requires no booking, and remains pending without affecting balances. Administrator approval posts one payment against the total account balance. Preserve the UUID idempotency key and original request for safe retries; changed requests return 409. Receipt duplicates against this account, including booking history, return 409.

Does not allocate money to a booking or create booking invoices. Booking-linked payment IDs return 404 on this route.

invoice_id.description: Selected latest outstanding invoice. Only valid on a matching booking payment route. If omitted on a legacy booking submission, the server binds the current invoice. Stale, foreign, paid or cancelled selections are rejected; idempotent replay still returns the original payment after newer versions are issued.

booking_id.description: Null for account payments; an existing booking association is retained on historical payments.

payment_date.description: Actual payment date, no later than the business date.

restore_credit.description: For trashed records, true only when moving to trash removed active credit; restoration otherwise preserves an existing reversal. Null for active records.
